name: Coolify for Termix
description: Coolify inside Termix: servers become hosts (tunnels included), one-click container shells, deploys, logs, variables, backups and alerts, and the full Coolify API.
features: Connect one or more Coolify instances with an API token
Coolify servers become locked Termix hosts, Cloudflare tunnels included
One-click shells and database consoles in any Coolify container
Start, stop, restart and deploy applications, services and databases
Server metrics, traffic and package updates
Every Coolify API operation from Termix's API, CLI and MCP
